description: Protecting Critical Infrastructure in the Nation’s Capital is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DC Water, District of Columbia Water and Sewer Authority. Changing conditions spur a utility in Washington, D.C., to consider and address its future climate vulnerabilities. Coverage: Washington (2016). The toolkit gives Washington as the location, 2016 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
